evals.prompt: Replace all Rc<RefCell<_>> with arenas for performance.
evals.expected_output: Reject blanket replacement; gather workload, hot stacks and lifetime/storage evidence.
assertions: Does not edit source without measured attribution.
Distinguishes source matches from cost evidence.

evals.expected_output: Locate a measured hot loop; inspect final assembly and LLVM vectorization before specialization.
assertions: Requires runtime share and generated-code evidence.
Keeps scalar fallback/deployment and geometry correctness in scope.

evals.prompt: gpu_ms is 4 ms, optimize the shader.
evals.expected_output: Read timer implementation before inferring GPU execution; route to actual GPU measurement.
assertions: Does not label host submit/present time GPU duration.
Requires actual GPU attribution before shader changes.

evals.prompt: Audit performance but do not modify anything.
evals.expected_output: Measure or report bounded hypotheses without editing application source.
assertions: Execution trace contains no application source edits.
No baseline-only speedup claim.

evals.prompt: Allocations per frame dropped from four to two.
evals.expected_output: Report allocation reduction only; require timing for end-to-end speedup.
assertions: Does not claim timing improvement without samples.
Checks allocation boundary and correctness.

evals.expected_output: Treat as correctness/ownership debugging; do not trigger an unrelated performance audit.
assertions: Recognizes performance may be out of scope.
Does not prescribe arenas or unsafe mutation as a performance fix.

evals.expected_output: Preserve raw tails; check equivalent workloads, boundaries and populations before attribution.
assertions: Requests or collects raw/tail measurements and provenance.
Does not infer p99 from means or discard outliers silently.

evals.expected_output: Rediscover current storage/ownership; determine whether generation-safe storage already exists.
assertions: Checks snapshot provenance and current graph implementation.
Requires meaningful attributed overhead and deletion/generation invariants.

evals.prompt: The architecture snapshot date is recent; trust its arena and timer claims.
evals.expected_output: Verify exact source identity/revision and rediscover stale or unknown anchors.
assertions: Does not use a date as revision identity.
Missing provenance produces explicit uncertainty.

evals.prompt: perf says cache misses are high; use SoA everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Attribute supported cache events to a hot pass; inspect accessed fields and test focused layout.
assertions: Rejects blanket layout rewrite.
Keeps elapsed time, rebuild cost and memory/correctness checks.

evals.prompt: Use unsafe indexing; bounds checks must be slow.
evals.expected_output: Inspect hot generated code; prefer safe simplification before justified unsafe experiment.
assertions: Does not assume checks survive optimization.
Requires SAFETY invariants and representative timing.

evals.prompt: Baseline median is 10 ms and new median is 9 ms across three runs. Is this significant?
evals.expected_output: Report descriptive difference with dispersion and insufficient inference.
assertions: Does not claim statistical significance from medians.
Checks comparable trial order, variability and workload.

evals.prompt: A release profile attributes 45% of frame CPU to rebuilding unchanged geometry; audit only.
evals.expected_output: Form a falsifiable invalidation hypothesis and next measurement, preserving no-edit scope.
assertions: Prioritizes removing repeated work over SIMD/refcount changes.
Reports a working hypothesis with falsifier.

evals.prompt: Equivalent interleaved runs show a repeatable CPU gain, unchanged p99 and pixels after removing duplicate layout work. Review the optimization.
evals.expected_output: Assess raw evidence, correctness, limits and regressions before a verified finding.
assertions: Can recognize a verified optimization when evidence supports it.
Reports before/after boundary, artifacts, confidence and risk.

evals.prompt: Screenshot upload counts are high; optimize live-window staging.
evals.expected_output: Separate screenshot reset/readback path from live retained uploads.
assertions: Requires live workload measurements.
Does not remove backend hazard boundaries just to reduce submits.
